text:
maya: FYI deploy-bot paused promotion to prod: artifact upload failing with ETag mismatch, blocking the 23:00 UTC change window.

deploy-bot: Promotion paused: artifact-index checksum mismatch for apps/frontend@sha256:abc123. Action required: manual pin or rerun.

kevin: copy — dropping in. Is this the build that passed canary earlier? :thinking: 

lia: yes, canary passed functional tests but the artifact upload step to our mirror S3 failed during multipart commit. looks like an ETag vs computed-md5 mismatch.

jonathan: CI logs:
```
ERROR: multipart upload complete failed: 400 ETagMismatch
artifact: apps/frontend:sha256:abc123
local-md5: 3b5d5c3712955042212316173ccf37be
remote-etag: "9c8af9..."
```

kevin: can we reupload just the artifact (no rebuild) or is the cache corrupted?

lia: trying a reupload now, but last test showed the remote store returned different ETag even when we retried. suspect network proxy rewriting chunk boundaries under high parallelism.

sre-bot: Noted: cluster autoscaler rolled a node at 21:45 UTC. Possible in-flight multipart commit failure. Recommend retry with fewer parallel parts: --multipart-chunks 4

maya: Options: 1) pin deploy-bot to last-good image (apps/frontend@sha256:def456) and promote, 2) wait for CI team to confirm reupload (time unknown), 3) rollback release window.

jonathan: I'm +1 for pinning to last-good to unblock the window. We can schedule a rebuild after the window with a safer upload flag.

kevin: I'll take the pin. Updating release notes to mark the promoted revision and note: 'artifact upload retried and original SHA not available; pinned to previous good build; follow-up rebuild scheduled'.

ops-bot: Change window reminder: 23:00 UTC. If promoted before 22:45 we'll be clear. If not, we'll have to delay to next window.

maya: Decision: pin to apps/frontend@sha256:def456, apply manual promo, and open follow-up ticket to rebuild with --multipart-chunks 4. @kevin please run the manual pin and update notes.

kevin: Doing it now. Running deploy-bot manual promote command:
```
deploy-bot promote --service apps/frontend --sha def456 --reason "ETag mismatch on latest artifact, pin prev-good image"
```

deploy-bot: Manual promote executed by kevin at 22:10 UTC — promotion started.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete. apps/frontend now at sha256:def456 in prod. :tada:

maya: Thanks all. kevin can you add the follow-up ticket and link to this thread? I'll add a line to the release notes.

kevin: done — ticket #INF-4123 created. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-4123

lia: CI will investigate root cause and try a non-parallel reupload in staging tomorrow.

maya: closing thread — we've unblocked the change window and captured follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
